product_one_liner.value: Vectary is a browser-based design platform that helps designers, architects, marketers and creative teams develop concepts with AI and create, share and embed interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI concept development and interactive 3D/AR creation in the browser; the company profile identifies designers, architects, marketers and creative teams as users and describes sharing and embedding. Sources: https://www.vectary.com/ and https://linkedin.com/company/9411207

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a Pro AI plan, satisfying the requirement even without quoting a price. Source: http://vectary.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Vectary’s success-stories page describes Sharp integrating its platform and Dowina implementing its configurators, establishing both as customers rather than investors or partners. Source: https://www.vectary.com/success-stories | named_customers.0: The success story describes Sharp integrating Vectary into its workflow and website. Source: https://www.vectary.com/success-stories | named_customers.1: The success story describes Dowina implementing Vectary’s configurators for customers and internal processes. Source: https://www.vectary.com/success-stories

employee_band.notes: The employee directory reports approximately 18 employees as of October 2026, which falls in the 11–20 band. This is a third-party estimate. Source: https://leadiq.com/c/vectary/5a1da3a22300005e0095dac6/employee-directory

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Vectary’s company-controlled LinkedIn profile explicitly lists Redwood City, California as headquarters. It is preferred over conflicting third-party location records. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/9411207 | hq_country: The company’s LinkedIn profile identifies Redwood City, California as headquarters, and the jobs profile explicitly places that headquarters in the United States. This is preferred over conflicting third-party Bratislava and Dover listings. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/9411207 and https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/vectary

founded_year.notes: Vectary’s company profile explicitly lists 2014 as its founding year. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/9411207

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents product tutorials, workflows, inspiration and marketing content, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how Vectary itself is built. Source: https://www.vectary.com/3d-modeling-blog/

public_docs.notes: Vectary maintains a public documentation site with a documentation index and product articles, including image-to-3D guidance, plus a public developer portal linking to Viewer API documentation. Sources: https://help.vectary.com/, https://help.vectary.com/documentation/other/image-to-3d-model.md and https://vectary.github.io/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Vectary’s public job board states that it has not added any jobs, supporting no listed qualifying AI/ML/data-science opening. Source: https://wellfound.com/company/vectary/jobs

model_provider.value: Hunyuan 3.1, Hunyuan 3, Tripo H3.1, Tripo 2.5, Pixal 3D, Trellis 2, Trellis, Meshy 6, Meshy 5 and Rodin 2.
model_provider.notes: Vectary’s image-to-3D documentation explicitly lists all ten models returned in the answer. Source: https://help.vectary.com/documentation/other/image-to-3d-model.md

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page claims SOC 2 certification and compliance with ISO 27001 and GDPR. These are public claims, not independent verification of certification; HIPAA and PCI DSS are not included. Source: http://vectary.com/security | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly says Vectary is SOC 2 certified. Source: http://vectary.com/security | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly claims compliance with ISO 27001. Source: http://vectary.com/security | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly claims GDPR compliance. Source: http://vectary.com/security

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: CB Insights explicitly classifies the January 2023 $4.6 million round as Series A. Other aggregators use Seed or Venture Round, so the classification is not unanimous. Source: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/vectary/financials | funding_date: CB Insights dates the latest round January 25, 2023, and Indexed independently identifies January 2023 as the most recent funding month; normalized to YYYY-MM. Sources: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/vectary/financials and https://indexed.vc/companies/vectary | funding_amount_usd: CB Insights identifies the latest round as $4.6 million in January 2023; the filing summary corroborates the amount and month. These newer records take precedence over a funding history ending in 2020. Sources: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/vectary/financials and https://www.noairlab.ai/companies/vectary-inc

raised_18mo.notes: Both funding histories place the most recent round in January 2023, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. Sources: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/vectary/financials and https://indexed.vc/companies/vectary

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Vectary’s public job board lists no jobs, hence no SDR, BDR or account-executive openings there. Source: https://wellfound.com/company/vectary/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: The Vectary Canvas launch page records an October 15, 2026 launch for AI-accelerated ideation across 2D, 3D and AR, within the six-month window. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/products/vectary/launches/vectary-canvas

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated professional profile records a Vectary Chief Revenue Officer tenure ending in May 2026, within the preceding 12 months. The conclusion relies on a profile rather than a company departure announcement. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/revenuegrowthleader

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable documentation homepage and developer-resources page name no CRM or sales/marketing systems. The empty list records that negative finding, not a claim that Vectary uses no such systems internally. Sources: https://help.vectary.com/ and https://vectary.github.io/
